scenes.say: You can be a genuinely winning player and still be losing after ten thousand hands.
Results are skill plus variance. Short term, variance wins.

scenes.say: A hot streak doesn't make you good. A cold one doesn't make you bad.
Judge skill on a big sample, and expect long losing runs even when you're right.
